message: Astra: Within Ya na’s investigation, does the draft show whether she actually signs the chart, or only that signatures were requested? What can you establish from the written scene, and what remains uncertain? Would closer thought about that gap earn its time over a small writing attempt now; what uncertainty would justify postponing the attempt? Which observable detail would help you decide? Can you briefly name your chosen next intention and carry it out, keeping the relationship correction aside?
